<!-- pr-reviewer: 426dde6e7a84a55f094ec996ac751696da8fcdfc -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The fixture now supplies the required Drill field. The `Tip` value agrees with the migration for legacy operations. The new test checks the mill default without a document machine. Both machine transition tests remain.

I checked the changes against the current upstream main laws and issue #2533.

Local results after a clean trial merge with upstream/main `7b4dc0d8995d79a0b783271d4e99c08f32f27e2a`:

- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --lib --no-run`: passed.
- From `crates/ui`, `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --lib -- --test-threads=6`: 1154 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored. This includes all three `drill_advice_` tests.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `git diff --check upstream/main`: passed.

The build used the worktree's own target directory with the inherited compiler wrapper disabled. No GitHub runner ran.

Requested before merge: none.

This PR changes tests and a decision record only. It changes no production UI, posted G-code, safety checks, stock simulation, or geometry. No goldens move. UI screenshots do not apply. I did not run mutations, ignored tests, or the release gate.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 426dde6e7a84a55f094ec996ac751696da8fcdfc -->
**Verdict: ready**

Trial merge with main 7b4dc0d89, built locally (`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=6`). The merge had no conflicts.

- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: pass.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib height_memo_machine`: the build passes. This filter selects 0 tests (1162 filtered out). The module path is `height_memo::machine_tests`.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib drill_advice_`: 3 passed, 0 failed.
  - `height_memo::machine_tests::drill_advice_without_document_machine_uses_mill_default`
  - `height_memo::machine_tests::drill_advice_follows_document_machine_from_mill_to_lathe_and_back`
  - `height_memo::machine_tests::drill_advice_follows_document_machine_from_lathe_to_mill_and_back`

Findings:

1. The diff changes only `crates/ui/src/height_memo_machine_tests.rs` and adds `docs/decisions/2533-drill-fixture.md`. It has no snapshot PNG, no `PROCESS_VERSION` change and no workflow file.
2. The fixture sets `break_through_from: BreakThroughFrom::Tip`. This is the legacy value: `crates/app/src/project/params_impl.rs` (near line 2473) sets absent keys to `Tip` on load. Thus the fixture keeps its old meaning, and the tests still test the same behaviour.
3. The new test `drill_advice_without_document_machine_uses_mill_default` is a small, valid addition. It does not change production code.
4. The PR body has `Fixes #2533` and a `Changelog:` line.

No blockers.
